notes: Specs drawn from Extron's official combined datasheet "ShareLink 250 W and ShareLink 200 N Specifications" (part 4568-D8; mirrored copy fetched via esistemas.pt because extron.com blocks automated fetches; cross-checked against Extron's ShareLink 250 W User Guide 68-2822-01). HDMI output has no version stated on the datasheet (max resolution given is 1920x1080@60Hz) so HDMI grade is omitted rather than guessed. Analog audio output is a 3.5mm stereo TRS mini-jack (tip=L, ring=R, sleeve=Gnd), modeled as trs-3.5 output. HDMI carries embedded 2-channel PCM digital audio (not a separate physical port) so it is not listed separately. Power is via an external desktop adapter (100-240VAC in; 5VDC/2.6A/13W out) terminating in a DC power jack on the unit — modeled as dc-barrel (exact barrel diameter not published); the unit can alternatively be powered via PoE (802.3at class 0/type 1) over the same RJ45 data port rather than a second physical power connector, so PoE is not listed as a separate port. Ethernet is Gigabit-capable (10/100/1000Base-T) — graded eth-1g. The 3 USB Type-A ports are USB 2.0 hosts (for the USB Player feature) — graded usb-2.0. Enclosure is a compact half-rack-width "puck" (1.0"H x 6.51"W x 3.3"D) that needs an optional 1U rack shelf accessory to rack-mount, so rackUnits is omitted (not natively rack-mountable). Category/type chosen as closest fit for a wireless/wired BYOD content-sharing gateway; no better match exists in the given enum (it is not truly a network switch, converter, or media player in the traditional sense). Integrated dual-band 802.11a/b/g/n wireless AP is a wireless interface, not physical wired I/O, so it is omitted per task scope.

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: Female HDMI Type A output, up to 1920x1080@60Hz, with embedded 2-channel PCM digital audio. No HDMI version stated by manufacturer, so grade omitted.

ports.name: VGA Out
ports.note: Female 15-pin HD (DE-15) RGBHV output, up to 1920x1080@60Hz.

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: 3.5mm stereo mini jack, unbalanced analog audio output (tip=L, ring=R, sleeve=Gnd).

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: Female RJ-45, 10/100/1000Base-T, half/full duplex with autodetect. Also accepts Power over Ethernet (802.3at, class 0/type 1) to power the unit.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: One of 3 identical USB Type-A host ports (high-speed USB 2.0) for the USB Player feature (flash-drive playback of documents/photos/video/audio).
